autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry binding the listeners when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

listeners.title: Listeners
listeners.description: Local endpoints that receive StatsD metrics. Every listener must bind for the job to start.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Transport to receive StatsD metrics on. UDP and TCP, the default, listens on both at the same address.

address.title: Address
address.description: Local address to listen on, as `host:port` with a numeric port.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Names of the profiles to apply, in precedence order. Leave empty to show every metric on automatic charts only.

max_series.title: Series limit
max_series.description: Maximum number of distinct metrics, counting each label combination separately. New metrics above the limit are rejected; existing ones keep updating.

metric_idle_timeout.title: Metric idle timeout
metric_idle_timeout.description: How long a metric may receive no updates before it is removed, as a duration such as `30m` or `2h`. Zero keeps idle metrics until the job restarts.

max_tcp_connections.title: TCP connection limit
max_tcp_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous TCP clients across the job's TCP listeners. New clients above the limit are disconnected.

listeners.ui:help: Over TCP, every metric line must end with a newline, including the last one.

address.ui:help: Use `127.0.0.1` to accept metrics from this host only. Leave the host empty (`:8126`) to listen on all interfaces.

profiles.ui:help: A profile renames or relabels matching metrics and defines charts for them. Each name refers to a `<name>.yaml` (or `.yml`) file in the `statsd.profiles/` directory of the plugin's configuration directory, for example `/etc/netdata/statsd/statsd.profiles/`. Profiles are read when the job starts.

metric_idle_timeout.ui:help:
Units include `s`, `m`, `h` and `d`; a plain number is seconds.

Until a metric is removed, an idle gauge keeps showing its last value, and idle counters, timers and sets report no activity.

max_series.ui:help: Rejected updates appear as `capacity` on the StatsD rejected input chart. Idle metrics count toward the limit until the metric idle timeout removes them.

max_tcp_connections.ui:help: Refused clients appear on the StatsD refused TCP connections chart. A connected client keeps its slot even while it sends nothing.
